## Checklist
- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): summary` (the hook checks this)
- [ ] `scripts/check.sh` passes on my computer
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test, or a note in `TEST-CHECKLIST.md` if only a person can check it
- [ ] New screen text exists in English **and** German
- [ ] Nothing typed by the child, and not the child's name, goes to the LLM or to logs
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased* (for changes users or parents will notice)
